analysis: 用户需要制作一个'猫咪的一生'主题的交互式 HTML 网页，包含 kitten（小猫）→ 成猫 → 老猫 三个成长阶段。要求：可独立打开、可交互（点击展开每个阶段、hover 动画等），包含 CSS + JS + SVG。

plan.reason: 使用 canvas-design skill 生成完整的交互式 HTML+CSS+SVG 页面，包含猫咪一生主题的多阶段交互设计
plan.prompt:
Create an interactive single-page HTML document about 'The Life of a Cat' (猫咪的一生). The page should have three main sections that users can click to expand:

1. Kitten Stage ( kitten / 小猫期): 0-6 months
   - Icon/SVG of a tiny cute kitten
   - Interactive expandable panel showing: milk-drinking, playful, first litter box, first vet visit
   - Hover animation: kitten jumps or purrs

2. Adult Cat Stage (成猫 / Adult): 6 months - 10 years
   - Icon/SVG of a fully-grown beautiful cat
   - Interactive expandable panel showing: independence, finding home, hunting instincts, territory marking, social bonds
   - Hover animation: cat stretches elegantly

3. Elder Cat Stage (老猫 / Elder): 10+ years
   - Icon/SVG of a wise old cat
   - Interactive expandable panel showing: silver fur, slower pace, cuddling, wisdom, golden years
   - Hover animation: cat closes eyes peacefully

Design requirements:
- Beautiful visual design with SVG illustrations (cat icons, decorative elements)
- Smooth CSS animations (fade in, slide up, hover effects)
- Interactive expand/collapse for each stage (click to expand, smooth transition)
- Modern, warm color palette (soft pinks, creams, warm grays)
- Responsive layout, works on mobile
- Single self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS and JS
- Include a beautiful hero/header with title
- Each stage should have SVG cat illustrations (cute, hand-crafted look)
- Add subtle background animations (floating cat paws, etc.)
- Add statistics/interesting facts for each stage
- The entire page should be a complete, beautiful, polished work of art
- Use proper semantic HTML, clean CSS with custom properties, vanilla JS
- Include accessible features
- This is a complete interactive website, not a simple poster

merge_instruction: The single HTML file from canvas-design is the final deliverable. Copy it to G:\oh-my-pi\workspace\cat_life.html as the final output.
